problem: The pinned default GitHub provenance predicate lacked the custom source.dirty and A.M.Y material fields required by the pre-selection P3 adapter retained in the upstream audit.

basis: The selected construction preserves the pinned action's standard GitHub SLSA predicate without claiming that it emits A.M.Y-specific fields.
One authenticated subject avoids cross-attestation subject or identity ambiguity.
Platform-derived provenance and workflow-authored release assertions remain structurally and linguistically separate.
Source snapshot and dependency-lock assertions can be cross-bound to payload entries authenticated by the same manifest.
The source snapshot is deliberately specified as opaque exact bytes; this profile makes no package-only claim that its tar members reconstruct the declared Git tree.

rejected_tradeoffs.dual_standard_and_custom_attestations: Adds a second predicate, cross-attestation equality rules, and another ambiguity/failure surface without making workflow-authored values independently true.
rejected_tradeoffs.custom_slsa_build_type: Would require a new public build-type specification and could be mistaken for GitHub's default provenance assurance.
rejected_tradeoffs.reduce_p3_to_default_fields_only: Would remove the clean-source and material controls that motivate the P3 research question.

selection_record.not_yet_evidence: Selection is not a frozen profile, real A.M.Y attestation, independent review, or registration gate completion.

workflow_authored: any custom predicate or manifest metadata
never_established_by_attestation: honesty of a compromised authorized workflow

candidate_profiles.construction: Use the unmodified default actions/attest SLSA predicate. Put schema-validated A.M.Y clean-state and material assertions in the exact manifest bytes authenticated as the sole Statement subject.
advantages: Retains the upstream GitHub build type without adding undeclared external parameters.
Requires one attestation and one unambiguous verified result.
Makes platform-derived and workflow-authored claims structurally separable.
required_changes: Add a versioned build-metadata object to the manifest schema and policy.
Revise P3 to validate the upstream workflow/source dependency plus authenticated manifest metadata.
Revise provenance operators, oracle, fixtures, and proposition wording before registration.

candidate_profiles.construction: Require one default GitHub SLSA provenance attestation and one separately typed A.M.Y custom-policy attestation over the same manifest digest.
advantages: Preserves standard provenance while isolating custom assertions in a distinct predicate type.
required_changes: Publish and freeze the custom predicate schema and URI.
Require exactly one verified result for each expected predicate type.
Define cross-attestation identity and subject-equality checks.

candidate_profiles.construction: Use custom action mode with a documented A.M.Y-specific SLSA build type containing the extra external parameters and dependencies.
advantages: Can encode all current P3 fields in one predicate.
required_changes: Publish a complete build-type specification and verifier rules.
Do not describe it as the default GitHub-generated predicate or inherit GitHub's default-provenance assurance without separate justification.

candidate_profiles.construction: Keep only fields emitted by default actions/attest and remove dirty/material claims from P3.
advantages: Smallest production implementation and clearest upstream interoperability.
required_changes: Remove unsupported operators and narrow every claim, RQ, conclusion, and threat-model statement accordingly.

freeze_requirements: Independent human review of the selected profile and trust-boundary wording.
Machine-readable schema and exact JSON pointers for every enforced field.

Keep every protocol, oracle, proposition, and manuscript statement within the selected opaque snapshot-byte boundary; any future Git-tree-equivalence claim requires a separately specified and tested verifier.
Real clean A.M.Y run plus negative controls under the selected profile.
No remaining policy/template or implementation disagreement.
Protocol, oracle, catalog, proposition matrix, and manuscript use identical claim boundaries.
forbidden_until_frozen: A real A.M.Y release has passed the selected P3 profile with default actions/attest provenance.
GitHub or Sigstore independently certifies a clean checkout or every A.M.Y material.
A valid attestation establishes scientific correctness.
